name: Öresund
note: Crossed by the Öresund Bridge linking Copenhagen and Malmö.
description: The Öresund is the busiest of the three Danish straits that connect the Baltic Sea to the world's oceans, a sound narrow enough that Copenhagen and Malmö face each other across it. For four centuries Denmark grew rich on the Sound Dues levied at Elsinore — Hamlet's castle at Kronborg still watches the narrows. Since 2000 the Öresund Bridge and tunnel have joined Denmark and Sweden directly, carrying trains and cars over and under a strait that remains the Baltic's front door.
